2609.35749.title: Towards Communication-Efficient Social Intelligence in Language Agents
2609.35749.paper_summary: Socially intelligent language agents must negotiate, coordinate, and resolve conflicting preferences while respecting the time and attention of both participants. Balancing these demands is challenging because agents must convey enough to address a partner's constraints and advance their goals without adding words that do not help the interaction. In this paper, we propose Teacher-Assisted Communication Training (TACT) to improve social goal attainment while reducing communication cost, making interactions with agents more productive and less demanding. We first characterize communication efficiency in terms of action strategy and expression, whose effects extend beyond the current utterance to the partner's response and subsequent exchanges. We design TACT to revise student-generated actions, test the revisions through partner responses, and distill useful feedback into the student. An expression specialist removes unnecessary detail while preserving the intended action, while a strategy specialist proposes alternatives that may better address the partner's constraints. To determine which revision helps, TACT samples a partner response for each candidate and selects a teacher reference by balancing local goal support against action-token cost. That reference guides on-policy distillation on the student's own generation prefixes, allowing the student to act independently at deployment. We evaluate TACT on SOTOPIA and AgentSense. On SOTOPIA, it achieves the highest Goal among the evaluated methods on All and Hard while using substantially fewer target tokens than SFT+SDPO. On AgentSense, it improves goal success over the initial student while reducing target tokens and interaction messages.
2609.35749.paper_summary_zh: 社交智能語言代理必須在尊重雙方參與者的時間和注意力的同時，協商、協調並解決衝突的偏好。平衡這些需求是具有挑戰性的，因為代理必須傳達足夠的信息以解決夥伴的限制並推進他們的目標，而不增加無助於互動的詞語。在本文中，我們提出了教師輔助溝通訓練（TACT），以提高社交目標的達成，同時降低溝通成本，使與代理的互動更具生產力且要求更低。我們首先從行動策略和表達的角度來描述溝通效率，其影響超越當前的話語，延伸至夥伴的回應和隨後的交流。我們設計TACT來修訂學生生成的行動，通過夥伴的回應測試這些修訂，並將有用的反饋提煉給學生。一位表達專家在保留預期行動的同時，去除不必要的細節，而一位策略專家則提出可能更好地解決夥伴限制的替代方案。為了確定哪個修訂有幫助，TACT對每個候選者抽樣夥伴回應，並通過平衡當地目標支持與行動標記成本來選擇教師參考。該參考指導學生在自己的生成前綴上的政策蒸餾，使學生在部署時能夠獨立行動。我們在SOTOPIA和AgentSense上評估TACT。在SOTOPIA上，它在所有評估方法中達到了最高的目標，並在Hard上表現最佳，同時使用的目標標記顯著少於SFT+SDPO。在AgentSense上，它提高了初始學生的目標成功率，同時減少了目標標記和互動消息。
